s.how: Melt 60g butter with 250g marshmallows over low heat. Stir through 150g puffed rice cereal until coated. Press firmly into a greased ring mould and set for an hour. Turn out and cut into wedges at the table.

s.note: the one they sleep on overnight
s.how: Beat 100g soft butter with 200g icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla until fluffy. Spread thickly between two large dark chocolate cookies, about 20cm across, pressing gently. Chill 20 minutes and cut into wedges.

m.how: Whisk 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 500ml buttermilk and 2 eggs. Pour into a large buttered pan over low heat, cover and cook 8 minutes, then flip with a plate and cook 5 more. Cut into wedges with butter and maple syrup.

w.note: camping out in the grass jungle
w.how: Toast 16 large marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under the grill until golden. Squash each between 2 plain biscuits with a square of milk chocolate (32 biscuits and 200g chocolate in total) and leave 30 seconds so the chocolate melts.

d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Stir with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Pour over ice in four glasses and drink it out on the lawn.
